verses.text: Listen to what the LORD says: "Stand up and state your case before the mountains. Let the hills hear what you have to say."
Listen, you mountains, to the LORD's charge. Listen, you everlasting foundations of the earth. The LORD has a case against his people. He is bringing charges against Israel.
"My people, what have I done to you? How have I made you tired of me? Answer me!
I brought you up out of Egypt and set you free from the land of slavery. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to lead you.
My people, remember what Balak king of Moab planned and what Balaam son of Beor answered him. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may know the good things the LORD did for you."
With what should I come before the LORD and bow down before God on high? Should I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams or with ten thousand rivers of olive oil? Should I offer my firstborn child for my rebellion, my own child for my sin?
He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. And what does the LORD ask of you? To act with justice, to love faithful mercy, and to walk humbly with your God.
The LORD is calling to the city, and it is wise to respect his name: "Listen to the rod of punishment and to the one who sent it.
Wicked people, am I still to forget your treasures you got by cheating, and your short measures, which are cursed?
Should I let people go free who use dishonest scales and bags of false weights?
The rich people of the city are full of violence. Its people are liars, and their tongues speak deceit.
So I have begun to strike you down, to ruin you because of your sins.
You will eat but not be satisfied. Your stomachs will still be empty. You will store things up but save nothing, because what you save I will give to the sword.
You will plant but not harvest. You will press olives but not use the oil. You will crush grapes but not drink the wine.

You have followed the laws of King Omri and all the practices of Ahab's family. You have followed their advice. So I will turn you into a ruin and make your people a joke. You will bear the scorn of the nations."
